author: Glitchaye
body:
(Made by Myself, EmeraldSword85, And Sulorak, thank you to Alexanderjoe10 for hosting the server!)
(And an extra thank you to AwarriorVenom for helping me out greatly!)
Alright guys, THIS is the map I'm submitting to the contest. I call it "New World"





You can tell why I named this map "New world" because.. It resembles a Minecraft world, from the first layer to the bottom layer. And Ill go in-depth about every layer.

Layer 1 (Sky) - Clouds , a sun and a beautiful rainbow, This is where you'll begin.
Layer 2 (OverWorld) - Grassy land with a hill, many trees, and an oasis on each side of the island, this is where you'll fall if you mess up on Layer 1
Layer 3 (Cavern) - A cold stone floor encrusted with ores-a-plenty, also with old bridges of miners that were here previously, along with an abandoned mineshaft type room.
Layer 4 (The Nether) - A Hellish environment but at the same time, a beautiful one. This is where it starts to get tricky as you have not as much room as the other layers, but you can still last a while here.
Layer 5 (The End) - The home of the Ender dragon, and floating above your demise, The Void. With an Obsidian and endstone platform to run on, with large obsidian pillars on each side of the platform, this is almost the end of your journey.
Layer 6 (The Void) - Your final chance, In the void there are broken up wool blocks to get one last try at lady luck to survive, be careful and time your jumps well!

YML

Download

Gallery

Enjoy guys!
